restart.pending: The panel address, webhook endpoint or data directory changed. Restart to apply.

login.title: Sign in to the panel
login.hint: The password is stored in webui.password in the configuration file. It is generated on first start and printed to the console.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.description: Bots and OneBot connections, refreshed every 5 seconds.
dashboard.history_window: CPU and memory usage over the last {{minutes}} minutes, updated every 5 seconds.
dashboard.disk_hint: Capacity and usage of the partition that holds the data directory, not the size of the CatOfficial folder.
dashboard.disk_unavailable: Could not read the capacity of the data partition

bots.title: Bots
bots.description: Official bots are relayed as OneBot. OneBot bots are only used to recognise real QQ and group numbers when binding identities.
bots.empty_hint: Add an official bot with its AppID and AppSecret, or sign in by scanning a QR code.
bots.name: Name
bots.name_placeholder: Leave empty to use the bot nickname
bots.app_secret_keep: Already set. Leave empty to keep it.
bots.webhook_hint: Webhook delivery needs the webhook port in Settings and the callback URL set on the developer platform.
bots.subscribe_hint: Requires the matching permission, otherwise the platform rejects the connection.
bots.auto_ack_hint: Responds to button clicks immediately so the user's client does not keep spinning.
bots.url_hint: Forward WebSocket of the OneBot bot (e.g. NapCat), such as ws://127.0.0.1:3001
bots.token_keep: Already set. Leave empty to keep it.
bots.onebot_hint: It must be in the same group as the official bot. When a member sends a binding phrase and both receive it, the real QQ number is linked. Its messages are not forwarded to apps.
bots.qr_hint: Scan with mobile QQ and confirm. The bot is saved automatically.
bots.qr_done: Signed in. The bot has been saved.
bots.delete_confirm: Delete bot "{{name}}"? Connections that used it will serve the remaining bots.
bots.manual_login: Can't scan? Enter the secret manually
bots.back_to_qr: Sign in with QR code instead
bots.reverse_hint: CatOfficial listens on the address below. Add a "WebSocket client" in the network settings of NapCat or another OneBot implementation to connect here.
bots.forward_hint: CatOfficial connects to the "WebSocket server" opened by NapCat or another OneBot implementation.
bots.rescan: Sign in again with QR code

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: How OneBot apps connect to CatOfficial. Each connection has its own token, message format and bots.
connections.empty_hint: Add a connection so OneBot apps such as NoneBot or Koishi can connect.
connections.hint_http_server: Apps call http://host:port/<action> to send messages and query data.
connections.hint_ws_server: Apps connect to ws://host:port/ for events and actions; /event for events only, /api for actions only.
connections.hint_http_client: Events are POSTed to the app; the app's response can reply directly.
connections.hint_ws_client: CatOfficial connects to the app's reverse WebSocket, one connection per bot with X-Self-ID.
connections.name: Name
connections.token_hint: Leave empty to disable the check.
connections.secret_hint: When set, requests carry X-Signature: sha1=…
connections.report_self_hint: Messages sent by the bot are also reported as message_sent events.
connections.bots_hint: Select none to serve every official bot, including ones added later.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Messages received and sent through CatOfficial. This is also the index for quoted replies and get_msg. Retention is set in Settings.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Recent runtime logs. The latest 3000 lines are kept and refreshed every 2 seconds.

bindings.title: Identity bindings
bindings.description: Link an OpenID of the official bot to its original QQ or group number, so data your OneBot app keeps by number carries over. Only a mapping is stored; no data is moved.
bindings.how: Members can also bind themselves: send ".bind <phrase>" in a group where both the official bot and the OneBot bot are present, or ".bind email <QQ>" to bind with an email code. See Settings.
bindings.pending_hint: Each regular member who binds adds a vote for the group. The group number is linked at {{required}} votes, or as soon as the owner or an admin binds.
bindings.name: Name
bindings.unbind_confirm: After unbinding, {{number}} returns to a number assigned by CatOfficial. Continue?
bindings.form_hint: Enter the number CatOfficial currently assigns, or the OpenID.
bindings.qq_hint: The original QQ or group number

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Changes are saved and applied immediately; the panel address, webhook endpoint and data directory need a restart.
settings.webhook_hint: Only needed by official bots that receive events by webhook. By default it shares the panel port; the callback URL is the panel address plus the path. The callback needs public HTTPS, usually behind a reverse proxy. Restart after changing.
settings.smtp_hint: Used for runtime error notices and email codes for identity binding.
settings.smtp_password_keep: Already set. Leave empty to keep it.
settings.bind_confirm: Members needed to link a group
settings.bind_confirm_hint: Each regular member who binds adds a vote; the owner or an admin links the group immediately.
settings.bind_email: Allow binding with an email code
settings.new_password_hint: Leave empty to keep it. At least 6 characters.
settings.public_warning: Listening on 0.0.0.0 makes this reachable from other machines. Make sure a strong password or access token is set.
settings.bind_hint: Members bind themselves with this command. Phrase binding needs a OneBot bot in the same group, added under Bots; email codes need the email settings above.
settings.masters_hint: Masters can link a group directly with ".bind group <number>" and receive runtime error notices by private message. A member can see their OpenID with ".bind status", or look it up on the Identity bindings page.
settings.notify_masters: Notify masters by private message on runtime errors
settings.notify_emails_hint: Press Enter to add. Several addresses are allowed.
settings.smtp_test_hint: The test email goes to the first notification address.
settings.master_need_bot: Choose an official bot for every owner
settings.bind_email_hint: Users send “{{command}} email <QQ number>”; the code is sent to that number’s QQ Mail (number@qq.com).
settings.retention_hint: Messages older than this are deleted; 0 keeps them forever.

about.title: About
about.description: A relay that turns the QQ official bot into a standard OneBot V11 implementation.
about.license: Released under AGPL-3.0. Apps that connect to CatOfficial over OneBot are not bound by this license.

markdown.label: Formatting
markdown.heading: Heading
markdown.preview_empty: Type on the left to see the result here.
markdown.shortcut_hint: Ctrl+B bold, Ctrl+I italic, Ctrl+Enter to send.

chat.title: Live chat
chat.description: Read conversations and reply as the bot.
chat.empty: No conversations yet. They appear here once the bot receives messages.
chat.pick: Select a conversation on the left
chat.placeholder: Type a message. Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.image_limit: Choose an image up to 20 MB.
chat.passive_hint: Messages reply to the other side’s latest message from the last 60 minutes; without one they are sent as active messages, which the platform limits.
chat.markdown_hint: Edit on the left with a live preview on the right. Images can use references from the official image host.
chat.at_all_hint: The bot must be a group admin, and each group allows this once per day.
chat.toggle_side: Show or hide the details panel
chat.passive_short: Replies to their message from the last 60 minutes, otherwise sends an active message
chat.members_seen: The member list API is not available to this bot; only members who have spoken are listed.
chat.kick_block_confirm: Removes “{{name}}” from this group and adds them to the blocklist so they cannot request to join again.
chat.admin_required: The bot must be a group admin to read or change these.
chat.bind_hint: After binding, OneBot apps see this conversation under the real number, so data stored by number carries over.

replies.title: Custom replies
replies.description: CatOfficial replies directly when an incoming message matches a rule.
replies.name: Name
replies.form_desc: Multiple conditions can require all or any to match; when several replies exist, one is chosen at random by weight.
replies.var_hint: Click a variable to insert it at the cursor. {a|b|c} picks one at random; with a regex, {$1} is the first capture group.
replies.ph_keyword: The whole message must match, e.g. #co
replies.regex_invalid: Invalid regular expression; it will be rejected on save.
replies.result_weight_hint: Chances follow the share of each weight; 0 means never.
replies.limit_cd_hint: Per group in groups, per user in private chats
replies.bots_hint: Leave all unselected to apply to every official bot.
replies.pass_through_hint: When off, matched messages are answered by CatOfficial and not reported to OneBot connections.
replies.err_need_cond: Add at least one condition with content
replies.empty_hint: Select “Add reply” to create the first rule.
replies.reset_confirm: Restores this rule’s conditions and reply to the defaults. Its enabled state is kept.
replies.try_hint: Enter a message to see which rule matches and what it replies. Chance and cooldown are ignored here; the sender is shown as “希亚”.

materials.title: Official image host
materials.description: Manage images in the official media API for use in Markdown messages.
materials.help: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 10 MB each and 100 images per bot. References belong to this bot and expire after 90 days without use. Select a thumbnail to view it.
materials.help_markdown: Use ![caption](qqbot-media://…) in Markdown messages; add #widthpx #heightpx after the caption to set the size.
materials.limit: Choose a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image up to 10 MB.
materials.empty: This bot has no images yet.
materials.no_bot_hint: Add an official bot under Logins first.
materials.offline: The bot is offline, so the image host cannot be read or changed.
materials.replace_confirm: Deletes the current image and uploads the new file. The old reference stops working immediately.
materials.delete_confirm: The reference stops working immediately, and replies that use it can no longer be sent. Messages already sent are unaffected.
